explore.hyde: Under the terms of our standard account agreement, customers are charged an overdraft fee when they exceed their available balance by more than $50. This means that if you fall into this category, you will be required to pay interest on any funds in excess of your current balance until it is replenished.

explore.q: How far can a Business Start customer go overdrawn before paying interest?

explore.hyde: Business Start customers are subject to a $50,000 overdraft limit per account. Any amount exceeding this limit will incur interest charges at a rate of 1% per day on the excess balance.

This amount is intended to cover meals during business-related activities but should not exceed reasonable spending limits without prior approval from management.
